headline: Nasdaq 100 Drops 6.4%, Erasing $2.5 Trillion as AI Trade Fails
summary: The Nasdaq 100 index fell 6.4%, erasing $2.5 trillion in market value as investors grew concerned about the AI trade amid soaring market fear gauges.
why: Rapid valuation corrections in mega-cap technology stocks heavily weighted in major indices can trigger broad market risk-off sentiment and liquidity contraction.
why_moved: A sharp decline across major technology components wiped out $2.5 trillion in market value, driven by investor pullback from artificial intelligence trades.
